subject: Pilot alignment: Starlift Health - finance & usage checklist
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@starlift.health>, Ava Simms <ava.simms@starlift.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-03T15:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot alignment: Starlift Health - finance & usage checklist

Hi Jordan / Ava —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a short checklist so we can move to a scoped pilot and deliver an invoice/sample cost schedule for your finance team. Please confirm the items below or flag anything I missed: 

- Target pilot scope: 90-day pilot, chat + support embeddings used in user profiles.
- Expected tokens (approx): 50M tokens/month baseline; ~200M tokens/month peak during campaigns. Please confirm splits if you track chat vs. embeddings separately.
- Target unit economics: you mentioned wanting to land around $10 / 1M tokens for baseline volume — confirm band ($/1M) you need to hit.
- Budget range: rough monthly budget band you have for pilot (helps pick reserved vs. burst config).
- Procurement timeline: do you need a PO, a PO + SOW, or a signed MSA first? Who is the procurement contact?

Attached is a quick token calculator (starlift_token_model.xlsx) that I filled with the numbers we chatted through — it shows a sample invoice at $10 / 1M and at $7 / 1M for comparison. Also linking the short pricing calculator we use: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bStarliftPilotDocs

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm volumes and target $/1M tokens this week.
2) We send a one-page invoice estimate and short MOU for finance.
3) If acceptable, we spin up pilot infra (2–3 business days after PO/MSA).

Happy to hop on a 15-min follow-up if helpful — I can propose times.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
[attachment: starlift_token_model.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@starlift.health>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava Simms <ava.simms@starlift.health>
Date: 2026-12-03T18:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot alignment: Starlift Health - finance & usage checklist

Thanks Marcus — solid summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Volumes: baseline is ~50M tokens/month (customer-facing chat ~40M, embeddings ~10M). Peak during marketing pushes could reach ~180–220M/month for ~2–3 weeks.
- Unit target: we'd like to target $9–11 per 1M tokens for the pilot; finance has asked us to aim for <= $10 if possible.
- Budget: pilot monthly budget available is in the $20k–$30k range; if we can show a path to $15k/mo at scale they'd be excited.
- Procurement: finance needs a sample invoice and a short statement of work. PO likely after the MOU; procurement contact is procurement@starlift.health.

If you can send the sample invoice and the cost assumptions (token mix, reserved vs on-demand), I can loop in procurement and finance next week.

Cheers,
Jordan
Director of Product — Starlift Health
jordan.matthews@starlift.health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@starlift.health>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-04T09:24:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot alignment: Pilot invoice sample + assumptions

Hi Jordan —

Appended an initial invoice estimate (starlift_invoice_estimate_v1.pdf) and a short assumptions sheet in the spreadsheet Marcus shared. High level:

- Scenario A (Baseline): 50M tokens/mo at $10 / 1M => estimated $500 / mo in token units (note: our billing increments and model selection/pricing vary — the spreadsheet breaks out chat vs embeddings, and per-token model multipliers).
- Scenario B (Peak): 200M tokens/mo at blended $8.5 / 1M => estimated $1,700 / mo token spend.
- Platform & support: we include a small monthly platform fee for Pilot reserved capacity, line-itemed in the PDF.

I flagged the cells where reserved capacity discounts kick in (20% at commit > 120M/mo). If you are expecting to exceed 120M/mo regularly, the numbers can be materially better.

I'll prepare a one-page MOU and a sample PO-ready invoice for procurement if you confirm the preferred $/1M target (you referenced $10).

Thanks — Marissa
Senior Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
[attachment: starlift_invoice_estimate_v1.pdf (pdf)]
From: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@starlift.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot alignment: Pilot invoice sample + assumptions

Marissa — this looks good. Procurement asked for a line-item invoice (showing token tiers, platform fee, and any initial setup). They also requested an ACH wire instruction block and Redwood's tax info.

Procurement timeline: target to issue PO by 2026-12-15 if we have MOU + line-item invoice by EOD 2026-12-07. I've cc'd the procurement alias below for their records.

procurement@starlift.health

I'll confirm the $/1M target internally but leaning to accept $10 / 1M for the pilot. If you can include the reserved discount tiers and a note about automatic failover to hosted endpoints in the invoice that helps our security review — they asked about fallback behavior for DR.

Thanks,
Jordan
